label: Fermented buttermilk
comment: The buttermilk of butter churned from soured milk or yoghurt rather than cream, as across North Africa, the Middle East, Ethiopia and South Asia. What is left of butter churned from the whole soured milk.

about.text: What is left when butter is churned from whole milk that has first been soured, rather than from cream: from dahi in South Asia, from ergo in Ethiopia and from soured milk in the Maghreb. A thin, sour drink, known as chaas or mattha in India and lben in Morocco.

links.name: Journal of Food Science and Technology (2020)

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Wild mesophilic lactic acid bacteria from the milk sour it at room temperature. Churning the soured whole milk then pulls out the fat as butter and leaves a thin, tangy, low-fat liquid.
